article.adventurer_note.title: Adventurer's Note
article.adventurer_note.content1: The ancient wanderer returns to the world
article.adventurer_note.content2: The homeland no longer exists, and the familiar but strange world is waiting for him
article.adventurer_note.chapter1.title: Prelogue · The Unconscious from Far Lands
article.adventurer_note.chapter1.body1: His familiar stars have no longer existed, which was replaced by endless darkness and quiet
article.adventurer_note.chapter1.body2: He could remember that tons of civilizations born under the stars, but faded in the long nights finally
article.adventurer_note.chapter1.body3: At last he woke up among the darkness, but the whole world never runs in his familiar way
article.adventurer_note.chapter1.body4: He picked out the strange thing in his pocket, only to find a shabby note
article.adventurer_note.chapter1.body5: The ancient boom era is coming to and end, and us who lived happily would eventually pass away
article.adventurer_note.chapter1.body6: In this strange world, you will have no companion and be all alone. But I can't explain the reason in detail to you. §lBriefly speaking, you will fulfill our dream of wandering for a thousand years.§r
article.adventurer_note.chapter1.body7: Survivors of "Alteration", our homeland has perished yet. Countless hardships have reduced even the hardest rocks to dust. You should have grown under the stars, but instead you were forced to waste your time in the cage.
article.adventurer_note.chapter1.body8: But at this very moment, the vast world is open for you to explore. The past and the future, history will be written by you.
article.adventurer_note.chapter1.body9: May you find your own answers after the slumber in a foreign land.
item.hiddenyears:copper_badge.usage: §7Within 10 minutes after wearing, the maximum health value will increase by 12 points. This bonus will disappear immediately after removing the artifact.§r
item.hiddenyears:golden_badge.usage: §7Within 10 minutes after wearing, the maximum health value will increase by 16 points. This bonus will disappear immediately after removing the artifact.§r

item.hiddenyears:mask_of_the_sea.usage: §7The Conduit Power effect will be granted within 5 minutes after wearing this item. The bonus will disappear immediately after removing the artifact.§r
item.hiddenyears:sparkling_mask.usage: §7The Night Vision effect will be granted within 5 minutes after wearing this item. The bonus will disappear immediately after removing the artifact.§r
item.hiddenyears:soldiers_helmet.usage: §7After wearing this item, the enemy will receive 5-12 points of damage each time you attack by a chance of 30%§r
item.hiddenyears:herders_hat.usage: §7After wearing this item, you'll obtain 1-5 more raw meats each time you kill a livestock or poultry animal§r
item.hiddenyears:farmer_hat.usage: §7After wearing it, you will receive 1-3 additional harvest items each time you harvest crops§r
item.hiddenyears:invisible_cape.usage: §7Wearing this cape grants a 10-minute invisibility effect. Once you remove this artifact, this bonus disappears immediately. §r
item.hiddenyears:thorns_cape.usage: §7When the enemy hits you, deal 2-8 thorn damage to them§r
item.hiddenyears:fire_cape.usage: §7 Wearing this cape grants a 10-minute fire resistance effect. Once you remove the artifact, this bonus disappears immediately. §r
item.hiddenyears:magic_feather_cape.usag: §7 Wearing this cape grants a 10-minute slow falling effect. Once you remove the artifact, this bonus disappears immediately. §r
item.hiddenyears:miners_glove.usage: §7Each time a block is mined, a 5-minute urgent effect is granted. §r
item.hiddenyears:fighters_glove.usage: §7 Each attack will always deal an additional damage ranging from 3 to 10 points in reality, but there is an 80% chance of inflicting 1 to 4 points of backlash damage each time. §r
item.hiddenyears:engulf_glove.usage: §7 After wearing it, each attack will restore 1-5 points of our health. §r
item.hiddenyears:ruby_ring.usage: §7After wearing it, attacking creatures will grant the player additional experience points §r
item.hiddenyears:cursed_ring.usage: §7Every time you strike a creature after wearing this item, it will inflict Slow III for 15 seconds on the opponent.§r
item.hiddenyears:speed_boots.usage: §7Wearing this boots grants a 10-minute speed effect. Once you remove this artifact, this bonus disappears immediately. §r
item.hiddenyears:hare_boots.usage: §7Wearing this boots grants a 10-minute jump boost effect. Once you remove this artifact, this bonus disappears immediately. §r
item.hiddenyears:crucifix_runes.usage: §7After each attack, there is a 15% chance to instantly restore full health. If the character's health drops too low after being attacked, this effect will definitely trigger. §r
item.hiddenyears:gluttonous_runes.usage: §7By sacrificing 20 minutes of Hunger III, you will continuously gain 15 minutes of Strength V§r
item.hiddenyears:imprisoned_wing.usage: §7Each time an attack is made, it deals 8-12 points of true damage to all hostile creatures within a 10-meter radius (excluding the boss) and generates the corresponding particle effect §r
item.hiddenyears:ruby_runes.usage: §7 When worn, it grants the player a 20-minute boost in fire resistance and resistance, and also makes them immune to the experience-stealing skill of the Ruby King §r
item.hiddenyears:sand_runes.usage: §7Eliminate drought and dehydration after wearing, and provide 20 minutes of drought and dehydration immunity.

job.hiddenyears:traveler.desc: The wanderer of the old starry sky returns to the world. The homeland has already cracked, but this familiar yet strange world awaits him
job.hiddenyears:pastor.desc: The pastor is the guardian of faith. They guide people towards the light with sacred rituals and prayers
job.hiddenyears:warrior.desc: Soldiers are the embodiment of battle. They protect their homeland and people with courage and strength
job.hiddenyears:archer.desc: Archers are experts in long-range combat. They defeat their enemies with arrows and skills
job.hiddenyears:wizard.desc: Wizard is a researcher and user of magic. They use magic to create wonders and change the world
job.hiddenyears:swordman.desc: Swordsman is experts in combat. They defeat enemies with their swords and skills
job.hiddenyears:assassin.desc: Assassin is an expert in assassination. They defeat their enemies silently with speed and skill
job.hiddenyears:berserker.desc: The berserker is the passionate fighters who challenge everything with their blood
job.hiddenyears:paladin.desc: The paladin is the embodiment of justice. They protect the people and faith with their strength and faith
job.hiddenyears:amnesty_pastor.desc: The amnesty pastor is the guardian of faith. They use sacred rituals and prayers to guide people towards enlightenment
job.hiddenyears:orison_pastor.desc: The orison pastor is the guardian of faith. They use sacred rituals and prayers to guide people towards the light
job.hiddenyears:conjure_wizard.desc: The conjure wizard can summon spirit servants to assist in the battle
job.hiddenyears:arcane_wizard.desc: The arcane wizard are researchers and practitioners of magic. They use magic to create miracles and change the world
job.hiddenyears:magic_archer.desc: The magic archer is an expert in long-range combat. They defeat their enemies with arrows and magic

message.hiddenyears:first_destroy_ruby: After the excavation, you felt a moment of dizziness
message.hiddenyears:tenth_destroy_ruby.2: It seemed that you witnessed a blurry figure being torn apart under the lightning, emitting a blinding light. Even the night turned into a bright day
message.hiddenyears:fiftieth_destroy_rub: A sharp pain suddenly struck, as if countless needles were piercing into the body
Before my eyes, an ancient scene unfolds: You see the sun and the moon rising from the north, their dazzling light sweeping across the sky, and midnight suddenly becomes noon
But when everything was over - the morning no longer saw the rising sun from the east, and noon was as dark as night. Summer turned into winter, and winter turned into extreme cold
